exposure: Maternal mental disorders (grouped into six broad diagnostic categories)
Maternal mental disorder in the five years before birth
Maternal mental disorder in the one year before birth
cohort: A cohort of 38,592 singleton Aboriginal births in Western Australia between 1990 and 2015.
finding: Having a maternal mental disorder in the five years before birth was associated with an increased risk of several adverse perinatal outcomes among Aboriginal women, with risk ratios ranging from 1.26 for foetal distress to 2.00 for low birthweight.
